item.title: WordPress Development & SEO Expert Needed -- 3
item.description:
250-750 USD | SEO & WEBSITE DEVELOPER (WordPress) — Remote, Monthly Pay
About Us Our Company helps entrepreneurs start and grow their businesses. Our wordpress website is our storefront, and organic search is a core growth channel. We are hiring one person to own both: keep our WordPress site running perfectly and grow qualified organic traffic that turns into leads, sign-ups, and customers.
Starting Pay $300 USD per month, paid monthly. Pay is earned by completing the listed tasks and metrics on a signed weekly checklist, released after a 4-week+ review, paid upon completion of KPI metrics.
Schedule Flexible remote, fixed hours workday with a 30-minute lunch. Daily short written update to Admin; weekly report every Friday.
What You Will Do
Website Developer (WordPress site health) - Keep every page working perfectly on mobile, tablet, and desktop: no broken layouts, menus, images, links, or forms. - Test login, sign-up, password reset, order buttons, checkout, and all forms end to end. - Keep page speed under 3 seconds and Core Web Vitals green. - Run plugin, theme, and WordPress core updates on staging first, with a current backup, then apply live. - Fix issues the same day or escalate with a screenshot and page URL. - Weekly cross-browser check (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge).
SEO & Organic Growth - Publish 100 SEO-optimized templated pages per month (25 per week) through our page generator, using our master template. Upkeep and edit master templates as needed. - Do keyword research: long-tail, intent-driven, clustered, one primary keyword per page. - Earn 100 quality backlinks per month (DR 30–50+) through manual outreach. No PBNs, link farms, spam directories, or paid link networks. Paid placements require written approval in advance. - Technical SEO: keep Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, and Screaming Frog warnings at zero. Fix redirects, 404s, indexing, schema, and speed issues. - Conversion engineering: every page has a clear value proposition, benefit-driven H1, primary call to action, trust elements, and verified event tracking. - First 30 days: establish a documented baseline for organic sessions, leads, registrations, purchases, and conversion rate, and propose weekly/monthly growth targets for approval. Then report baseline vs. target vs. actual every Friday.
Member Website Publishing - Own customer website publishing requests from intake to completion: connect domains, verify DNS and SSL, publish the site, test layouts/forms/links, and confirm completion with the customer. - Set up staging builds and handle customer DNS updates. - Occasional quick WordPress pages or micro-sites using native Gutenberg blocks.
Tools You Will Use WordPress, Rank Math, Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and our internal SEO dashboard (keyword pipeline, page generator, rank tracker).
Requirements - Proven WordPress experience: themes, plugins, staging, backups, troubleshooting. - Working SEO knowledge: on-page, technical, keyword research, and manual link outreach. - Comfortable in Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, and Screaming Frog. - Gutenberg block editor experience (no third-party page builders). - Strong written English for daily and weekly reports. - Reliable internet and consistent daily availability. - You own routine fixes yourself and escalate only access, budget, security, or major platform decisions — with evidence and a recommended next step.
How We Measure Success (KPIs) - 100 new quality-checked SEO pages per month - 100 audited quality backlinks per month - Site load under 3 seconds; zero open technical warnings at week end - Weekly acquisition report every Friday; keyword report every Monday - Zero broken pages, forms, or layouts left open past 24 hours - Organic sessions, leads, registrations, and purchases growing against the approved baseline
How To Apply Send: (1) a short intro, (2) links to 2–3 WordPress sites you have managed or built, (3) one example of SEO results you produced (traffic, rankings, or links — with dates), and (4) your expected monthly rate. Applicants who complete a short paid test task move to the front.

I will only invest in Shopify ads once the site proves it can make me money organically. 2. Customer reviews must be prominently featured on this front page. * About Us Section: Somewhere in the middle or toward the bottom of the homepage, I want our Mission statement (which is focused on our family legacy) and a picture of my husband, Cody, and me. Alternatively, we can use my logo (the alligator smoking a cigar in a crystal forest). * Retail vs. Wholesale: I want an easy, clear setup with distinct Retail and Wholesale pages. Within those pages, products need to be broken down cleanly into categorized collections. I will rely on your design expertise for the best way to execute this. * Spiritual Meanings Page: I am working on a separate page/listing that explains the spiritual meanings of my items for retail stores. However, my main following is on my personal TikTok page, while my actual business/shop page has very low followers. I need your guidance on how to fix or navigate this. 6. Communication & Working Hours * I work from home, so my sleep schedule can be irregular. * If you have questions, please text me. Feel free to text me multiple times because I sometimes miss notifications. If I do not respond for a few hours, assume I am asleep, but I will answer as promptly as I can. 7. Future Work & Retainer Agreement * My goal is simply to afford my bills and a few luxuries without bleeding money on subscriptions. * The Goal: If these updates help my Shopify generate a healthy revenue of $500 over the next 30 days starting today, I will put aside $100/month to keep you on a monthly retainer for maintenance. * Bonus Project: If you deliver on all of this and the site runs perfectly, I have a completely separate website for my mother's business that I will hire you to work on next. Let me know that you understand and agree to all of these points so we can get started!

item.title: Harden WordPress Firewall & Server
